title: What If We Paved a Road With Solar Panels? France Did

scenes.text: What if a road made electricity? France paved one kilometer with solar panels.
It opened in Normandy in December 2016 and cost about five million euros in state aid.
The plan was 642 megawatt hours. Through March 2019, it produced just 229.
Panels cracked and broke, and the speed limit dropped to 70 kilometers an hour. Reports blamed tractors, leaves and a cloudy region.
It earned about 8,000 euros, against 22,000 expected.
Officials called it a failure and planned new panels on only 400 meters. A surface that carries traffic and makes power is hard.

description:
What if a road made electricity?
A kilometer of French solar road produced about a third of the energy planned.
What should we run through next?
